The '''Emperor's library''' was a large [[Library/Legends|library]] located in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It belonged to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and only his top people were allowed to use it&mdash;among these people were his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Attendants helped those who were permitted to use the library and the data retrieval stations were equipped with sophisticated search programs. There were large [[Datacard/Legends|data card]] filing cabinets in the library as well as three [[Computer/Legends|computer]] stations through which the user could access records that were used to track [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] citizens.<ref name="Allegiance" />
